notes: «وكان عمرو - يعني ابن دينار - يقول هم من آبائهم» gives a different wording under another transmitter for the same saying: a variant group, not a route (rule 4)
«- يعني ابن عبد الله -» is an editor's gloss; «قال الزهري ثم نهى» is the narrator's remark, not a link
Al-Sa'b asked the Prophet and is the last link (rule 5, the asker)
